rawContent: This reminds me of tweets that I saw about the #metoo movement being delayed in the hip hop community. This might be the beginning.

So, I'm just going to say it now that these "oh because it's not the usa no one's talking about it" tweets scream antiblackness to me because literally 99% of the shit that be on the TL be about #BlackLivesMatter and I'm tired of y'all thinking that you are fucking slick with it.

Non-Black PoC see Black people as like ✨special✨ because people tweet #BlackLivesMatter and businesses post their #BHM content, but do not acknowledge WHY it is that way. Hypervisibility is not what y'all think it is and it is so foul the way y'all talk about Black folk.

So, I am on Google right now and the front page says "See how America is searching to support Asian communities and #StopAsianHate". 

I would like the Asian Community to stop asking people why no one supports them like #BlackLivesMatter. 

Thanks.

Asian people tweeting me that I care more about a "hashtag" than Asian lives is precisely why #AsianLivesMatter is not ok. #BlackLivesMatter is not a hashtag. It is a movement. It is a liberation movement. Y'all calling it "just a hashtag" is gross and disgusting.
